articles.title: Big Upsets at the China Open as Sabalenka Falls to Bartunkova
articles.summary: Rising Czech player Nikola Bartunkova upset world number two Aryna Sabalenka, a day after the top seed also lost in Beijing.

articles.title: New Lord of the Rings Movie Is Still on Its Way
articles.summary: Warner Bros. says Stephen Colbert's Lord of the Rings movie is still in development, despite a rumor that it was paused.

articles.title: "The Chase" Goes on a Treasure Hunt Around Europe
articles.summary: ITV Studios is turning quiz show "The Chase" into a puzzle-filled treasure hunt across Europe, one of 10 new shows it announced.
